items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Gus was a close friend of Sy Oliver.

ctx.x: Oh, this is the Gus you were talking about?

Yeah. He did quite a bit of arranging for the band, Roy was in the band, and Vic Dickinson, who's Reinald Elvin Jones in the trumpet section. Gus was a close friend of Sy Oliver. Sy Oliver in those days

used to arrange for -- played trumpet for Zach White's band and we were in the Speed Webb Band. We'd run into them very often on the road, stay in the same hotel, play, very often, battles of music. So Sy has always been a great fan of Gus for that arranging.
